name: formbuilder-plugin-hapi-terminology
description: Terminology plugin backing packages/core's TerminologyProvider contract with a self-hosted HAPI FHIR JPA terminology server - search/lookup/validate against external terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10-GM/OPS) and full CRUD+lifecycle management of self-authored custom terminologies, all in the same server.

scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=core && npm run build --workspace=plugin-api && npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.js
